newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firm as crude rises.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firm as crude rises.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly stronger on Monday, traders said.
Gas oil rallied around $5 a tonne. Heating oil barge premiums rose up to $2 a tonne on cold weather demand. Cargoes were inactive.
Gasoline retraced Friday's losses, led higher by strong NYMEX unleaded which put on over two cents. Naphtha was marginally stronger with crude futures. Activity was still slow.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil was steady to firmer, while low sulphur was steady to weaker, sapped by market length and low demand.
